    Functorial finiteness of wide subcategories #

    Theorem 5.1 (thm:wide, condition (wide) in Theorem A(I)): studies simple objects of wide subcategories and establishes isEFinite_iff_functoriallyFinite_wideClasses, showing over an arbitrary field that R is E-finite if and only if every wide subcategory of mod R is functorially finite.
